"'''Twisted'''" is a song by American singer [[Keith Sweat]], released as a single in June 1996. It was the first song released from his [[Keith Sweat (album)|self-titled fifth album]]. R&B group [[Kut Klose]] and remix rapper Pretty Russ are also featured on the song. The radio version of "Twisted" omits Pretty Russ' rap before the final chorus, though some [[urban contemporary|urban]] stations kept the rap verse. A second mix of the song, referred to as the Flavahood Sexual remix, features a different backbeat sampled from [[Marvin Gaye]]'s song "[[Sexual Healing]]". "Flavahood" also saw significant airplay on radio but was never released on an album.

Commercially, "Twisted" spent three weeks at No. 1 on the US ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs|Hot R&B Singles]] chart and peaked at No. 2 on the ''Billboard'' [[Billboard Hot 100|Hot 100]], becoming Sweat's biggest hit. "Twisted" also peaked at No. 1 on the ''Billboard'' [[Rhythmic Airplay|Top 40/Rhythm-Crossover]] chart, staying there for 14 consecutive weeks, the most amongst any song except [[TLC (band)|TLC]]'s "[[No Scrubs]]", which spent 15 weeks at the top position. Outside the US, "Twisted" topped the [[Recorded Music NZ|New Zealand Singles Chart]] for six weeks and became a top-20 hit in Australia and the Netherlands. In 2012, [[VH1]] ranked the song at number 35 on their list of the "40 Greatest R&B Songs of the '90s".<ref name=VH1>{{cite web|url=http://www.freeonsmash.com/news/2012/07/05/vh1s-the-40-greatest-rb-songs-of-the-90s/|title=VH1's The 40 Greatest R&B Songs Of The '90s|publisher=FreeOnSmash.com|date=July 5, 2012|access-date=July 9, 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130814071228/http://www.freeonsmash.com/news/2012/07/05/vh1s-the-40-greatest-rb-songs-of-the-90s/|archive-date=August 14, 2013}}</ref>
